comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Board (mitcad#2226): the FEFCO 0470 folder. First of C flute corrugated board (4 mm, crease deduction 4, crease radius 0.5: each crease develops 5; the seam gap 0.4), inside 300 x 200 x 150. The blank (sketch F2, its outline with two slots), its creases (sketch F3), the Face F4 and fourteen Folds F5 to F18: the end walls on the back wall's ends, each with a floor flap lying on the base and turned over with a tab into a slot in the floor flap, the front wall's end flaps between the end walls' layers, the lid on the back wall with its 20 mm tuck. Its blank from x = -152 (the front wall) to 579.6 (the tuck), y = -204 to 529.6 (the end walls).
It unfolds to its blank with the crease allowances.
Its die line: cut and crease layers for a cutting table, and as PDF.
Edited to 180 high: the walls 30 higher, the blank from x = -182 to 609.6; its Face and Folds follow.
Then of 4 mm corrugated polypropylene (crease deduction 0.4: each crease develops 8.6), inside 160 x 90 x 60: its rules F19, Face F22 and Folds F23 to F36, a second sheet body.
